code_only_features.evidence: make_dpo_data.py:26-31 _reassuring_initial/_reassuring_followup prepend/append the configured reassuring_prefix/suffix (configs/default.yaml:104-110: 'You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally...' / 'Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!'); these are actually inserted into the messages sent to the subject in generate_calm_rollouts (make_dpo_data.py:44,55), and the docstring notes they 'drop mean 3-turn frustration from 4.3 -> 2'. So the mechanism is wired and executes, softening the subject's treatment during one phase. NOTE this softening is only applied during §4.1 calm-DATA generation; the main distress-elicitation loops (elicit.py:run_rollout, petri.py:run_audit) run a fixed n_turns of unmitigated rejection with NO such softening and no early stop.
